text: Follow-up to feature covering stash A9D74372 (Stage harvest docline hardening): (a) Direction 3 DEFERRED from that chore — change how the Stage harvest commit reaches the Ship feature branch so a Stage-artifact defect (beyond docline frontmatter, e.g. committed-file scope) cannot ride into a Ship PR. Options: Stage pushes its harvest commit to origin/main before Ship branches, or harvest lands via a dedicated delivery mechanism. Larger blast radius (branch/push topology, partly Ship-owned) — evaluate before implementing. (b) Upstream template drift: the docline frontmatter contract + pre-harvest lint gate were applied to the in-repo .github/skills/impl-plan/SKILL.md and harvest/SKILL.md, but the generating .tmpl sources live in the external autoharness repo; update them there (never via out-of-tree writes from this workspace, per Principle IV) so a regeneration does not overwrite the fix. Source: plan-review of docs/exec-plans/2026-07-02-stage-harvest-docline-frontmatter-hardening-plan.md, 2026-07-02.
Follow up: audit standalone plugin agent/skill copy and verify-plugin drift target after canonical .github/plugin manifest change

Publish backlogit to a Copilot CLI plugin marketplace. The CLI now warns direct plugin installs (repos, URLs, local paths) are deprecated and only plugin@marketplace installs will be supported in a future release. Direct 'copilot plugin install softwaresalt/backlogit' works today but will eventually break. Investigate registering backlogit in a marketplace (marketplace.json) so plugin@marketplace install keeps working.
